health.technicalBasis: GitHub Pages returned 200 on 2026-08-14. Reachable, but superseded.
knownBlockers: Ends at the claim code with no score breakdown, philosophy selection or replay.

governance.notes: Both remain publicly reachable on GitHub Pages, so a student could still land on the incomplete build. Deciding whether to retire that deployment is a BOW call.

provenance.evidence: Franchise-Sim/index.html and BSC-201-Capstone/index.html share an identical title, GameState field order, intro copy, screen structure and tfr_* storage keys. Franchise-Sim was committed 2026-01-08 with 17,565 lines and 71 functions; BSC-201-Capstone on 2026-01-11 with 22,092 lines and 78 functions, adding the cap timeline and the full ending.
